grade_reason: No statement by Nancy Lacore about AI of any kind was found in news coverage of her 2026 campaign or on her campaign site.
notes: Six web searches ran; none refused. Results covered her campaign (retired Navy vice admiral, former Navy Reserve chief, fired by Defense Secretary Hegseth in 2025; won SC-01 on 3 November 2026) but none mentioned AI. Opened her campaign site https://www.nancylacore.com/ and its Priorities page https://www.nancylacore.com/priorities: seven priorities (leadership and integrity, financial freedom, those who serve, the coast, border, reproductive freedom, money in politics), with no mention of AI, technology or China. As a representative-elect she held no seat in 2026, so she could not have co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act; no House letter was found. Results about data center moratoria concerned Rep. Nancy Mace, a different person, and were excluded. Debate transcripts and candidate questionnaires were not specifically searched, so a passing AI remark there could have been missed.
